# Contract: Embeddings Index and Similar Search

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- Docker Engine with Compose v2 is installed and its daemon is running
- `uv` is on PATH and can provision Python 3.12; backend dependencies are installed with `uv sync` in `backend/`
- a PostgreSQL 17 server with the `vector` extension available (the `db` service of `docker-compose.yml`) is running and healthy
- the database reached through the supplied database URL has its schema initialized (application tables present, `vector` extension installed) and holds no rows unless a Persistent state entry or an item says otherwise; items that need an uninitialized database state so in their `given`
- a stand-in for the OpenAI API is running on a loopback port it chooses and reports when it starts. It is part of this feature's own deliverables (under `backend/tests/mocks/`) and is described under External dependencies.

**Persistent state:**
- the 20 packaged seed bugs exist in `bugs`, all with status `open`, and no embedding exists; handle `seed-bugs`. Used by `SVC-INDEX-06`, `SVC-SEARCH-07`, `CLI-INDEX-04`, `CLI-SEARCH-05`.
- the 20 packaged seed bugs exist with one bug in status `processing`, two in status `processed`, one in status `failed` and the rest `open`, and no embedding exists; handle `seed-bugs-mixed`. Used by `SVC-INDEX-01`, `SVC-INDEX-04`, `CLI-INDEX-01`, `CLI-INDEX-02`, `CLI-INDEX-03`.
- the 20 packaged seed bugs exist, all `open`, and each has an embedding that is current for its text (as produced by the stand-in); handle `seed-indexed`. Used by `SVC-SEARCH-01`, `SVC-SEARCH-02`, `SVC-SEARCH-03`, `SVC-SEARCH-04`, `SVC-SEARCH-08`, `SVC-SEARCH-09`, `CLI-SEARCH-01`, `CLI-SEARCH-02`, `CLI-SEARCH-03`, `CLI-SEARCH-06`.
- 45 bugs exist titled "Batchbug 01" to "Batchbug 45", each with valid values for every column and status `open`, and no embedding exists; handle `forty-five-bugs`. Used by `SVC-INDEX-02`, `SVC-INDEX-03`, `SVC-INDEX-05`.
- exactly three bugs exist and no embedding exists; handle `trio`. Bug A: title "Checkout button unresponsive", description "Nothing happens when paying.", reproduction steps "Open the cart and pay.", system version "web 1.0.0", environment `production`, reporting team `support`. Bug B: title "Nightly report timeout", description "The report query exceeds ten minutes.", reproduction steps "Run the nightly job.", system version "api 2.0.0", environment `staging`, reporting team `data`. Bug C: title "Checkout page layout broken", description "Totals overlap on small screens.", reproduction steps "Resize the window.", system version "web 1.0.0", environment `production`, reporting team `frontend`. All three have status `open`. Used by `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-01`, `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-07`.
- the three bugs of `trio` exist and each has an embedding that is current for its text (as produced by the stand-in); handle `trio-indexed`. Used by `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-02`, `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-03`, `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-04`, `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-05`, `SVC-SEARCH-05`, `SVC-SIMILAR-01`, `SVC-SIMILAR-03`, `SVC-SIMILAR-04`, `SVC-SIMILAR-05`.
- the three bugs of `trio` exist and only bug A has an embedding that is current for its text; handle `trio-a-indexed`. Used by `SVC-SIMILAR-02`.

**Configuration:**
- two API keys for the stand-in: `sk-test-valid`, which it accepts, and `sk-test-invalid`, which it rejects with an authentication error. The invalid key is also the canary for leak checks. Used by `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-05`, `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-07`, `SVC-SEARCH-09`, `CLI-INDEX-03`, `CLI-SEARCH-06`.
- for service items the LLM client is built with the stand-in's `/v1` URL as an explicit base URL, the valid key, a 60-second timeout, 2 retries, the embedding model `text-embedding-3-small` and the chat model `gpt-4o-mini`, unless an item states otherwise; settings can be built with the root `.env` file disabled (an F01 deliverable)
- for CLI items the configuration comes only from the process environment: `DATABASE_URL` is set explicitly, `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set as the item states (unset when the item says so), the OpenAI client library's base-URL variable `OPENAI_BASE_URL` points at the stand-in's `/v1` URL, no other BugFlow variable is set, and no root `.env` file exists
- `TZ=UTC`

**External dependencies:**
- the OpenAI API is replaced by a local stand-in delivered with this feature. It answers `POST /v1/embeddings` with deterministic 1,536-dimension unit vectors in which texts sharing more words are more similar and no vector is all zeros; it answers `POST /v1/chat/completions` with a fixed reply text; it accepts only the key `sk-test-valid` and answers any other key with an OpenAI-shaped 401; it can be scripted to answer the next embedding requests with chosen statuses (429, 503, 400, 401), with a delay, or with vectors of a wrong size; it records every request (path, whether the key was accepted, model, number of inputs, temperature) and exposes the record, and the record can be cleared. No item needs network access or a real API key.
- the container image `pgvector/pgvector:pg17` is either already present locally or can be pulled from its registry

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready. All commands run from `backend/`.

- **Format** — `uv run ruff format .` — completes with exit code 0 and leaves the source tree formatted
- **Lint** — `uv run ruff check .` — completes with exit code 0 and reports no violations
- **Tests** — `uv run pytest` — completes with exit code 0; every non-integration test passes

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|

| Vectors have 1,536 dimensions and use `text-embedding-3-small` | SVC-LLM-CLIENT-01, SVC-INDEX-01 |

| `ensure_embedding` re-embeds a bug whose text changed and leaves an unchanged bug untouched | SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-01, SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-02, SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-03, SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-04, SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-05 |
| An invalid API key fails the index run with "OpenAI authentication failed" and no key in output; empty search text is rejected | CLI-INDEX-03, CLI-SEARCH-04, SVC-INDEX-05, SVC-SEARCH-06, SVC-LLM-CLIENT-05 |

## Service

**Verification mode:** Invoke the public function/method directly in-process on an initialized database with the stand-in reachable, using the session, engine or client the function takes; assert the returned value, thrown error, persisted side-effect, or the record of requests the stand-in received.

*Consumers outside this feature: F05 (Triage Agents) consumes `ensure_embedding`, `similar_to_bug` and the LLM client; F09 (API, Operations and Parity) consumes the index and search services, as declared in PRD Section 8.*

### LLM client

**Common given:** the stand-in is running with an empty request record; the client uses the default configuration of the Prerequisites (valid key, 60-second timeout, 2 retries) unless an item states otherwise.

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-01` — embeddings request
- given: (default)
- when: call `embed` with the three texts "alpha", "beta" and "gamma"
- then:
  - three vectors are returned
  - every vector has 1,536 numbers
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request
  - that request named the model "text-embedding-3-small" and carried 3 inputs

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-02` — transient rate limit is retried
- given: the stand-in is scripted to answer the next embedding request with status 429 and the one after with success
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - one vector is returned
  - the stand-in received exactly 2 embedding requests

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-03` — rate limit retries are bounded
- given: the stand-in is scripted to answer the next three embedding requests with status 429
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI rate limit exceeded"
  - the stand-in received exactly 3 embedding requests
  - the call took at least 1.5 seconds

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-04` — server errors are retried then reported
- given: the stand-in is scripted to answer the next three embedding requests with status 503
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI service unavailable"
  - the stand-in received exactly 3 embedding requests

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-05` — invalid key is not retried
- given: the client uses the key `sk-test-invalid`
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - the error text does not contain the key
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-06` — rejected request is not retried
- given: the stand-in is scripted to answer the next embedding request with status 400
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI request failed"
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-07` — timeout
- given: the client uses a 1-second timeout and 0 retries; the stand-in is scripted to delay its next embedding response by 3 seconds
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI request timed out"
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-08` — unreachable service
- given: the client uses 0 retries and a base URL on a loopback port with no listener
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "Cannot reach the OpenAI API"

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-09` — unexpected vector size
- given: the stand-in is scripted to answer the next embedding request with vectors of 3 numbers
- when: call `embed` with the text "alpha"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI returned an unexpected embedding size"
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-10` — chat with the default temperature
- given: (default)
- when: call `chat` with one user message "hello"
- then:
  - the stand-in's fixed reply text is returned
  - the request named the model "gpt-4o-mini"
  - the request carried a temperature not above 0.2

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-11` — high temperature refused
- given: (default)
- when: call `chat` with one user message "hello" and temperature 0.5
- then:
  - an error is raised before any request is made
  - the stand-in received no chat request

#### `SVC-LLM-CLIENT-12` — missing API key at creation
- given: settings without an API key
- when: create the client from the settings
- then:
  - a configuration error is raised with the message "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"

### Ensure embedding

**Common given:** the stand-in is running with an empty request record; the client uses the default configuration.

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-01` — missing embedding is created
- given: `trio` exists
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - the call reports that the embedding was written
  - an embedding row exists for bug A with a vector of 1,536 numbers
  - the stored text hash is 64 hexadecimal characters
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request carrying one input

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-02` — unchanged bug is left untouched
- given: `trio-indexed` exists
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - the call reports that nothing was written
  - the stand-in received no embedding request
  - the stored text hash and embedding time of bug A are unchanged

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-03` — changed title is re-embedded
- given: `trio-indexed` exists and the title of bug A was changed to "Checkout button broken"
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - the call reports that the embedding was written
  - the stored text hash of bug A differs from its previous value
  - the stored embedding time of bug A is later than before
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-04` — changed environment is re-embedded
- given: `trio-indexed` exists and the environment of bug A was changed to `staging`
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - the call reports that the embedding was written
  - the stored text hash of bug A differs from its previous value

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-05` — non-text changes do not re-embed
- given: `trio-indexed` exists and the reporting team of bug A was changed to `qa`
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - the call reports that nothing was written
  - the stand-in received no embedding request
  - the stored text hash of bug A is unchanged

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-06` — unknown bug
- given: no bug has id 999999
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for id 999999
- then:
  - a not-found error is raised with the message "Bug 999999 not found"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-EMBEDDING-ENSURE-07` — provider failure leaves nothing behind
- given: `trio` exists and the client uses the key `sk-test-invalid`
- when: call `ensure_embedding` for bug A
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - no embedding row exists for bug A

### Index all bugs

**Common given:** the stand-in is running with an empty request record; the client uses the default configuration.

#### `SVC-INDEX-01` — every bug is embedded whatever its status
- given: `seed-bugs-mixed` exists
- when: call `index_all_bugs`
- then:
  - the result reports 20 indexed of 20
  - exactly one embedding row exists for each of the 20 bugs, including the bugs with status `processing`, `processed` and `failed`
  - every stored vector has 1,536 numbers and every stored text hash is 64 hexadecimal characters
  - every embedding request received by the stand-in named the model "text-embedding-3-small"

#### `SVC-INDEX-02` — batches of at most 20
- given: `forty-five-bugs` exists
- when: call `index_all_bugs`
- then:
  - the stand-in received exactly 3 embedding requests
  - those requests carried 20, 20 and 5 inputs, in that order
  - the result reports 45 indexed of 45

#### `SVC-INDEX-03` — recorded run with progress and logs
- given: `forty-five-bugs` exists
- when: call `run_index` with the engine and a client factory
- then:
  - exactly one run of type `index` exists, with status `succeeded` and progress 45 of 45
  - the run has non-null `started_at` and `finished_at`
  - the run has at least 3 log lines

#### `SVC-INDEX-04` — rebuild replaces vectors without duplicates
- given: `seed-bugs-mixed` exists and each of its bugs already has an embedding
- when: call `index_all_bugs` again
- then:
  - exactly 20 embedding rows exist
  - the embedding time of every row is later than before
  - the stand-in received a request carrying 20 inputs

#### `SVC-INDEX-05` — a failing batch stores nothing
- given: `forty-five-bugs` exists; the stand-in is scripted to answer the first embedding request successfully and the second with status 401
- when: call `run_index` with the engine and a client factory
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - exactly 20 embedding rows exist, all from the first batch
  - the run has status `failed` and the stored error "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - the stored error does not contain the key

#### `SVC-INDEX-06` — missing API key
- given: `seed-bugs` exists and the settings have no API key
- when: call `run_index` with the engine and a client factory built from those settings
- then:
  - a configuration error is raised with the message "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"
  - the run has status `failed` and the stored error "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-INDEX-07` — nothing to index
- given: the `bugs` table is empty
- when: call `run_index` with the engine and a client factory
- then:
  - the result reports 0 indexed of 0
  - the stand-in received no embedding request
  - the run has status `succeeded`

### Search by text

**Common given:** the stand-in is running with an empty request record; the client uses the default configuration.

#### `SVC-SEARCH-01` — default limit
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "button does nothing" and no limit
- then:
  - exactly 5 items are returned
  - each item carries a bug id, a title, a status and a score
  - the scores never increase from one item to the next
  - the hint is empty

#### `SVC-SEARCH-02` — maximum limit
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "button does nothing" and limit 20
- then:
  - exactly 20 items are returned
  - the scores never increase from one item to the next

#### `SVC-SEARCH-03` — limit above the maximum
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "button does nothing" and limit 21
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with a field error for the field `limit`
  - the field error message is "must be between 1 and 20"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-SEARCH-04` — limit below the minimum
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "button does nothing" and limit 0
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with a field error for the field `limit`
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-SEARCH-05` — most similar first
- given: `trio-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "checkout button"
- then:
  - the items are the bugs titled "Checkout button unresponsive", "Checkout page layout broken" and "Nightly report timeout", in that order

#### `SVC-SEARCH-06` — empty text refused
- given: (default)
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "   " (whitespace only)
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "Search text must not be empty"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-SEARCH-07` — nothing indexed
- given: `seed-bugs` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "anything"
- then:
  - no items are returned
  - the hint is "No bugs are indexed; run index"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-SEARCH-08` — over-long text refused
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: call `search_similar` with a text of 501 characters
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with a field error for the field `text`
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `SVC-SEARCH-09` — invalid key
- given: `seed-indexed` exists and the client uses the key `sk-test-invalid`
- when: call `search_similar` with the text "button does nothing"
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - the error text does not contain the key

### Similar bugs

**Common given:** the stand-in is running with an empty request record; the client uses the default configuration.

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-01` — the bug itself is excluded
- given: `trio-indexed` exists
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for bug A
- then:
  - exactly 2 items are returned
  - the items are the bugs titled "Checkout page layout broken" and "Nightly report timeout", in that order
  - bug A is not among the items

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-02` — no other bug is indexed
- given: `trio-a-indexed` exists
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for bug A
- then:
  - the call completes without raising
  - the returned list is empty

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-03` — limit above the maximum
- given: `trio-indexed` exists
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for bug A with limit 21
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with a field error for the field `limit`

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-04` — limit of one
- given: `trio-indexed` exists
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for bug A with limit 1
- then:
  - exactly one item is returned
  - the item is the bug titled "Checkout page layout broken"

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-05` — own stale embedding is refreshed first
- given: `trio-indexed` exists and the title of bug A was changed to "Checkout button broken"
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for bug A
- then:
  - the stored text hash of bug A differs from its previous value
  - the stand-in received exactly one embedding request
  - exactly 2 items are returned

#### `SVC-SIMILAR-06` — unknown bug
- given: no bug has id 999999
- when: call `similar_to_bug` for id 999999
- then:
  - a not-found error is raised with the message "Bug 999999 not found"

## CLI

**Verification mode:** Spawn the binary with the given arguments and stdin; assert stdout, stderr, exit code, any direct persisted side-effect in the database the command targets, and the record of requests received by the stand-in.

### Help

#### `CLI-HELP-01` — new commands are listed
- given: (default)
- when: run `uv run bugflow --help` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout lists the command `index` with a one-line English description
  - stdout lists the command `search` with a one-line English description

### Index

**Common given:** the CLI environment of the Prerequisites with `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test-valid`, unless an item states otherwise; the stand-in's request record is empty.

#### `CLI-INDEX-01` — first index
- given: `seed-bugs-mixed` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow index` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout contains the line "Indexed 20/20 bugs"
  - exactly 20 embedding rows exist
  - the `runs` table holds exactly one run of type `index` with status `succeeded` and progress 20 of 20
  - that run has non-null `started_at` and `finished_at` and at least one log line

#### `CLI-INDEX-02` — repeated index
- given: `seed-bugs-mixed` exists and `uv run bugflow index` has already completed once
- when: run `uv run bugflow index` again
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout contains the line "Indexed 20/20 bugs"
  - exactly 20 embedding rows exist
  - the `runs` table holds two runs of type `index`, both with status `succeeded`

#### `CLI-INDEX-03` — invalid API key
- given: `seed-bugs-mixed` exists and `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test-invalid`
- when: run `uv run bugflow index` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - neither stdout nor stderr contains the key `sk-test-invalid`
  - no embedding row exists
  - the latest run of type `index` has status `failed` and the stored error "OpenAI authentication failed"

#### `CLI-INDEX-04` — missing API key
- given: `seed-bugs` exists and `OPENAI_API_KEY` is not set
- when: run `uv run bugflow index` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"
  - no embedding row exists
  - the latest run of type `index` has status `failed` and the stored error "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"

#### `CLI-INDEX-05` — schema not initialized
- given: the database is empty and has not been initialized
- when: run `uv run bugflow index` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "Database schema is not initialized; run 'bugflow db init'"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

### Search

**Common given:** the CLI environment of the Prerequisites with `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test-valid`, unless an item states otherwise; the stand-in's request record is empty.

#### `CLI-SEARCH-01` — default results
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow search "button does nothing"` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - the first stdout line is the header "SCORE  ID  TITLE  STATUS"
  - exactly 5 result lines follow
  - every result line starts with a score written with two decimals
  - the scores never increase from one result line to the next

#### `CLI-SEARCH-02` — maximum limit accepted
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow search "button does nothing" --limit 20` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - exactly 20 result lines follow the header

#### `CLI-SEARCH-03` — limit above the maximum rejected
- given: `seed-indexed` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow search "button does nothing" --limit 21` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "Validation failed: limit: must be between 1 and 20"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `CLI-SEARCH-04` — empty text rejected
- given: (default)
- when: run `uv run bugflow search ""` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "Search text must not be empty"

#### `CLI-SEARCH-05` — nothing indexed
- given: `seed-bugs` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow search "button does nothing"` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout contains the line "No bugs are indexed; run index"
  - the stand-in received no embedding request

#### `CLI-SEARCH-06` — invalid API key
- given: `seed-indexed` exists and `OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-test-invalid`
- when: run `uv run bugflow search "button does nothing"` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is non-zero
  - stderr contains "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - neither stdout nor stderr contains the key `sk-test-invalid`
